name: Chinese SimpleQA
intro: Chinese SimpleQA是首个全面的中文基准，旨在评估大型语言模型回答简短问题的能力。该基准涵盖6个主要主题和99个子主题，并通过严格的质量控制流程确保问题和答案的高质量。其特点包括中文、多样性、高质量、静态和易于评估，可用于指导开发者理解模型在中文事实性方面的表现。
org: LivingFutureLab, Tsinghua University, Beijing Institute of Technology, Shanghai Jiao Tong University
build_method: 知识内容筛选, GPT-4o生成, RAG与双人检索验证
eval_feature: 中文事实性, 静态知识截止2023-12-31, 多模型难度筛选, 权威来源验证
build_method_en: Knowledge filtering, GPT-4o generation, RAG and dual-human search verification
eval_feature_en: Chinese factuality, static knowledge through 2023-12-31, multi-model difficulty filtering, authoritative-source verification
intro_en: Chinese SimpleQA is the first comprehensive Chinese benchmark designed to evaluate large language models' ability to answer short questions. It covers 6 main topics and 99 subtopics, with strict quality control ensuring high-quality questions and answers. Features include Chinese language, diversity, high quality, static nature, and ease of evaluation, making it useful for developers to understand model performance on Chinese factuality.
drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2411.07140 Sections 2-3 and Appendix A. Chinese SimpleQA organizes six primary topics and 99 subtopics, filters knowledge-rich source content, generates QA pairs with GPT-4o-0806, checks objective/unique/timeless/by-2023-12-31 criteria, and verifies evidence through LlamaIndex over Google and Bing. It removes any question answered by all four difficulty models: GPT-4o, Meta-Llama-3-70B-Instruct, Qwen2.5-72B-Instruct, and GLM-4-Plus. Two independent annotators then recheck criteria, search for the answer, and each provide at least two authoritative URLs; disagreement goes to a third annotator, and only exact agreement with the generated answer survives. From 10,000 initial pairs, difficulty filtering leaves about 6,310, rule/RAG checks remove another 2,840, and human review yields 3,000 questions scored with CO, NA, IN, CGA, and F-score.
